$description: Token usage policy for PageSpecs and generators. Enforced: schema/semantic_validate.py TOKEN_* rules on node.styleTokens (PageSpec field added in pageSpecVersion 1.1.0); catalog drift is checked by extraction/verify_all.py.

rawValueRestrictions.color: reference tokens by path; never emit a raw literal
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: reference tokens by path; never emit a raw literal
rawValueRestrictions.fontSize: reference tokens by path; never emit a raw literal
rawValueRestrictions.fontWeight: reference tokens by path; never emit a raw literal
rawValueRestrictions.radius: reference tokens by path; never emit a raw literal
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: reference tokens by path; never emit a raw literal
rawValueRestrictions.elevation: reference tokens by path; never emit a raw literal
rawValueRestrictions.motion: reference tokens by path; never emit a raw literal

light.evidence: tokens/10-semantic/semantic.json $description per token (e.g. text.inverse 'text on dark surfaces', surface.numbered 'case-study numbered cards' rendered with white text in src/pages/cms/RichText.jsx)

unsupportedFonts.fontFamily.favorit: ABC Favorit TRIAL licence (assets/asset-roles.json fontFaces): evaluation only, never in a generated page for another brand.

enforced: asset roles are closed (schema enum + semantic validator) and mode-aware (clone / generation)
link targets are routes, anchors, dest:<role> or reserved .example/.invalid placeholder URLs (never a live URL)

styleTokens: unknown token (TOKEN_UNKNOWN), raw hex/rgb/px/font-stack values (TOKEN_RAW_VALUE), arbitrary spacing (TOKEN_ARBITRARY_SPACING), unsupported font (TOKEN_UNSUPPORTED_FONT), wrong category for a slot (TOKEN_SLOT_CATEGORY), invalid theme/token combination (TOKEN_THEME_COMBINATION)
convention: token references in prose guidance (README, section purpose)
overrides: AVAILABLE since pageSpecVersion 1.1.0 as node.styleTokens: a closed set of slots whose values are token paths only. Section/component contracts still own default styling; styleTokens is an optional, validated override.
